AMMClawback.tfClawTwoAssets: Makes the clawback withdraw both the clawed-back issued asset and its counterpart in the AMM pool, instead of only the specified asset. Can only be used by the issuer of an asset with asfAllowTrustLineClawback enabled.
AMMDeposit.tfLPToken: Deposits both pool assets in the current proportion and receives in return the exact amount of LPTokens specified in LPTokenOut.
AMMDeposit.tfLimitLPToken: Deposits a single asset (Amount) while capping the maximum LPTokens to receive (LPTokenOut), preventing receiving less than expected due to slippage.
AMMDeposit.tfOneAssetLPToken: Deposits a single asset (Amount) to obtain an exact amount of LPTokens (LPTokenOut); the asset amount is calculated automatically.
AMMDeposit.tfSingleAsset: Deposits only the asset specified in Amount, altering the pool's proportion; receives LPTokens proportional to the value contributed.
AMMDeposit.tfTwoAsset: Deposits both assets (Amount and Amount2) in the pool's current proportion to keep it unchanged, receiving LPTokens in return.
AMMDeposit.tfTwoAssetIfEmpty: Creates the initial funding of an empty AMM pool by contributing both assets in the specified amounts; only valid if the pool has no liquidity.
AMMWithdraw.tfLPToken: Withdraws both pool assets in the current proportion by burning the exact amount of LPTokens specified in LPTokenIn.
AMMWithdraw.tfLimitLPToken: Withdraws a single asset (Amount) while capping the maximum LPTokens to burn (LPTokenIn), protecting against a higher-than-expected cost.
AMMWithdraw.tfOneAssetLPToken: Burns an exact amount of LPTokens (LPTokenIn), receiving in return only the asset specified in Amount; the amount received is calculated automatically.
AMMWithdraw.tfOneAssetWithdrawAll: Withdraws the transaction sender's entire position, delivering the full equivalent in a single asset (Amount) and burning all of their LPTokens.
AMMWithdraw.tfSingleAsset: Withdraws only the asset specified in Amount, altering the pool's proportion; burns the LPTokens proportional to the value withdrawn.
AMMWithdraw.tfTwoAsset: Withdraws both assets (Amount and Amount2) in the pool's current proportion, burning the corresponding LPTokens without altering the price.
AMMWithdraw.tfWithdrawAll: Withdraws the transaction sender's entire liquidity position, delivering both assets proportionally and burning the totality of their LPTokens.
AccountRoot.lsfAllowTrustLineClawback: The account has clawback enabled on the trust lines it issues; corresponds to having activated asfAllowTrustLineClawback and is irreversible.
AccountRoot.lsfAllowTrustLineLocking: The account allows its trust lines to be used as lockable collateral by vaults or loans; corresponds to asfAllowTrustLineLocking.
AccountRoot.lsfDefaultRipple: New trust lines created by the account have rippling enabled by default; corresponds to asfDefaultRipple, typical of gateway accounts.
AccountRoot.lsfDepositAuth: The account requires prior authorization to receive funds from third parties; corresponds to asfDepositAuth.
AccountRoot.lsfDisableMaster: The account's master key is disabled and can no longer be used to sign; corresponds to asfDisableMaster. The account must have a regular key or signer list configured.
AccountRoot.lsfDisallowIncomingCheck: The account rejects the creation of new incoming Checks; corresponds to asfDisallowIncomingCheck.
AccountRoot.lsfDisallowIncomingNFTokenOf: The account rejects new NFT offers directed at it; corresponds to asfDisallowIncomingNFTokenOffer.
AccountRoot.lsfDisallowIncomingPayChan: The account rejects the creation of new incoming payment channels; corresponds to asfDisallowIncomingPayChan.
AccountRoot.lsfDisallowIncomingTrustline: The account rejects new trust lines opened toward it with no issued balance; corresponds to asfDisallowIncomingTrustline.
AccountRoot.lsfDisallowXRP: Informational signal that the account prefers not to receive XRP; corresponds to asfDisallowXRP and does not actually block XRP payments.
AccountRoot.lsfGlobalFreeze: All assets issued by the account are globally frozen; corresponds to asfGlobalFreeze.
AccountRoot.lsfNoFreeze: The account has permanently renounced the ability to freeze trust lines; corresponds to asfNoFreeze and is irreversible.
AccountRoot.lsfPasswordSpent: Indicates that the account has already used its free regular key change (SetRegularKey with no fee); the next regular key change will require paying the normal transaction fee.
AccountRoot.lsfRequireAuth: The account requires explicit authorization from the issuer for third parties to hold a balance of its tokens; corresponds to asfRequireAuth.
AccountRoot.lsfRequireDestTag: The account requires every incoming payment to include a DestinationTag; corresponds to asfRequireDest and to the transaction flag tfRequireDestTag.
AccountSet.asfAccountTxnID: Enables the account to store the hash of its last applied transaction, allowing the AccountTxnID field to be used in future transactions to chain them and prevent reordering.
AccountSet.asfAllowTrustLineClawback: Allows the issuer to execute Clawback to withdraw funds from its holders' trust lines; can only be activated if the account has never had asfNoFreeze active, and is irreversible once activated.
AccountSet.asfAllowTrustLineLocking: Enables the account's trust lines to be used as lockable collateral by features such as vaults or loans; a prerequisite for participating as an issuer in those systems.
AccountSet.asfAuthorizedNFTokenMinter: Designates, together with the NFTokenMinterAddr field, another account authorized to mint NFTs on behalf of this account via NFTokenMint with an explicit Issuer.
AccountSet.asfDefaultRipple: Enables rippling by default on all new trust lines of the account; typically activated on gateway issuer accounts to allow payments to pass through them.
AccountSet.asfDepositAuth: Requires prior authorization (via DepositPreauth) or that the payment come from the account itself in order to receive funds; blocks unsolicited deposits from any other account, including partial payments via Payment.
AccountSet.asfDisableMaster: Disables the account's master key, so that transactions can no longer be signed with it; requires having a regular key or a signer list configured beforehand, to avoid losing control of the account.
AccountSet.asfDisallowIncomingCheck: Rejects the creation of new Checks with this account as the recipient, preventing unwanted incoming checks.
AccountSet.asfDisallowIncomingNFTokenOff: Rejects the creation of new NFT offers (NFTokenCreateOffer) directed at this account, both buy and sell offers toward it.
AccountSet.asfDisallowIncomingPayChan: Rejects the creation of new payment channels (PaymentChannelCreate) that have this account as the recipient.
AccountSet.asfDisallowIncomingTrustline: Rejects third parties opening new trust lines toward this account; only applies to new lines with no issued balance, does not affect existing ones.
AccountSet.asfDisallowXRP: Indicates that the account prefers not to receive XRP payments; this is only an informational signal for clients, rippled does not actually prevent XRP from being sent to the account.
AccountSet.asfGlobalFreeze: Globally freezes all trust lines issued by the account, blocking the movement of its tokens across the entire network; requires not having asfNoFreeze active and can be reversed unless asfNoFreeze is also active when attempting to deactivate it.
AccountSet.asfNoFreeze: Permanently and irreversibly renounces the ability to freeze trust lines (tfSetFreeze/asfGlobalFreeze) in the future; once activated it cannot be deactivated.
AccountSet.asfRequireAuth: Requires the account to explicitly authorize each trust line (TrustSet with tfSetfAuth) before the counterparty can hold a balance of its tokens; can only be activated if the account has no trust lines with a balance or limit already set.
AccountSet.asfRequireDest: Requires every incoming payment to the account to include a DestinationTag; equivalent to the transaction flag tfRequireDestTag applied persistently.
AccountSet.tfAllowXRP: Removes the legacy DisallowXRP restriction, once again allowing the account to receive XRP payments. In practice rippled no longer enforces this restriction; it is a legacy flag with no real effect for years.
AccountSet.tfDisallowXRP: Marks the account as not wishing to receive XRP payments (informational only); rippled does not block payments even with the flag active, it is a legacy preference.
AccountSet.tfOptionalAuth: Removes the requirement for explicit authorization for third parties to open trust lines toward this account, reverting the effect of tfRequireAuth.
AccountSet.tfOptionalDestTag: Indicates that it is no longer mandatory to include a DestinationTag in incoming payments to this account, reverting tfRequireDestTag.
AccountSet.tfRequireAuth: Requires the issuer to explicitly authorize (TrustSet with tfSetfAuth) each trust line before that counterparty can hold a balance of the issued token; can only be activated if the account has no pre-existing trust lines.
AccountSet.tfRequireDestTag: Forces every incoming payment to this account to include a DestinationTag; protects against misrouted deposits from exchanges or other shared accounts.
Batch.tfAllOrNothing: Executes all inner transactions of the batch atomically: if any fails, all effects are reverted (except fee consumption) and none are applied.
Batch.tfIndependent: Executes each inner transaction of the batch independently, applying the result (success or failure) of each one separately without the failure of one affecting the others.
Batch.tfOnlyOne: Executes the inner transactions in order and stops after the first one that succeeds, ignoring the rest; fails if none succeed.
Batch.tfUntilFailure: Executes the inner transactions in order until one fails; those before that point remain applied and those after are not executed.
Credential.lsfAccepted: The credential has been explicitly accepted by the subject (CredentialAccept) and is therefore valid for use in permissioned domain verifications or other checks that require it.
DirNode.lsfNFTokenBuyOffers: Marks the directory node as a directory of NFToken buy offers, rather than a generic owner directory.
DirNode.lsfNFTokenSellOffers: Marks the directory node as a directory of NFToken sell offers, rather than a generic owner directory.
EnableAmendment.tfGotMajority: Pseudo-transaction issued by validators indicating that an amendment has reached the necessary support threshold; starts the waiting period before its activation.
EnableAmendment.tfLostMajority: Pseudo-transaction issued by validators indicating that an amendment that had a majority has lost sufficient support, cancelling its activation countdown.
Loan.lsfLoanDefault: The loan has been marked as defaulted after the grace period elapsed without receiving the payment due; allows the liquidation of the broker's coverage to begin.
Loan.lsfLoanImpaired: The loan is marked as impaired, reflecting default risk in the vault's accounting valuation even though the formal term has not yet expired.
Loan.lsfLoanOverpayment: The loan allows overpayments: payments (LoanPay) may include amounts above the amount due to pay down principal early; set at creation via LoanSet.
LoanManage.tfLoanDefault: Marks the loan (Loan) as defaulted after the grace period has elapsed without payment, allowing the broker or the vault to begin the process of liquidating the coverage.
LoanManage.tfLoanImpair: Marks the loan as impaired, reflecting that it is considered at risk of default even though the grace period has not yet expired; affects the vault's valuation.
LoanManage.tfLoanUnimpair: Reverses the impaired status of a loan, returning it to its normal status once the risk situation has been resolved.
LoanPay.tfLoanFullPayment: Indicates that the payment fully settles the loan, including closing interest and outstanding fees; the transaction fails if the amount does not cover the entirety of the debt.
LoanPay.tfLoanLatePayment: Indicates that the payment corresponds to a late installment and includes the interest and fees for the delinquency; the transaction fails if the loan is not actually in default.
LoanPay.tfLoanOverpayment: Allows the excess paid above the amount due to be applied as an overpayment (early principal repayment) instead of being rejected; requires the loan to have tfLoanOverpayment enabled at creation (LoanSet).
LoanSet.tfLoanOverpayment: When creating the loan, enables future payments (LoanPay) to include overpayments above the amount due in order to pay down principal early.
MPToken.lsfMPTAMM: The MPToken object belongs to an AMM pool rather than to a normal user account, identifying its special role within the AMM protocol.
MPToken.lsfMPTAuthorized: The holding account has been explicitly authorized by the issuer to hold a balance of this MPT; required when the issuance has lsfMPTRequireAuth active.
MPToken.lsfMPTLocked: This particular account's MPToken is locked, preventing it from transferring or receiving the token until the issuer unlocks it with tfMPTUnlock.
MPTokenAuthorize.tfMPTUnauthorize: Instead of authorizing or opting in to an MPToken, removes the prior authorization or the MPToken object of the account sending the transaction, reversing the token holding.
MPTokenIssuance.lsfMPTCanClawback: The issuance allows the issuer to execute Clawback on holders' balances; corresponds to having set tfMPTCanClawback or tfMPTSetCanClawback.
MPTokenIssuance.lsfMPTCanEscrow: The issuance allows the MPT to be used in Escrow objects; corresponds to tfMPTCanEscrow or tfMPTSetCanEscrow.
MPTokenIssuance.lsfMPTCanHoldConfidentia: The issuance allows holders to maintain confidential balances of this MPT; corresponds to tfMPTCanHoldConfidentialBalance or tfMPTSetCanHoldConfidentialBalance.
MPTokenIssuance.lsfMPTCanLock: The issuance allows the issuer to lock the entire issuance or individual MPTokens; corresponds to tfMPTCanLock or tfMPTSetCanLock, and enables the use of tfMPTLock.
MPTokenIssuance.lsfMPTCanTrade: The issuance allows the MPT to be traded on the order book via OfferCreate; corresponds to tfMPTCanTrade or tfMPTSetCanTrade.
MPTokenIssuance.lsfMPTCanTransfer: The issuance allows holders to transfer the MPT directly between themselves, not only with the issuer; corresponds to tfMPTCanTransfer or tfMPTSetCanTransfer.
MPTokenIssuance.lsfMPTLocked: The entire issuance is locked, preventing any transfer of the MPT by all holders until the issuer unlocks it with tfMPTUnlock.
MPTokenIssuance.lsfMPTRequireAuth: The issuance requires the issuer to explicitly authorize each account (MPTokenAuthorize) before it can hold a balance of this MPT; corresponds to tfMPTRequireAuth or tfMPTSetRequireAuth.
MPTokenIssuanceCreate.tfMPTCanClawback: Allows the MPT's issuer to execute Clawback to seize tokens from holders; incompatible with having issued the MPT as non-clawbackable.
MPTokenIssuanceCreate.tfMPTCanEscrow: Allows this MPT to be deposited in an Escrow (EscrowCreate), enabling conditional or deferred payments in the token.
MPTokenIssuanceCreate.tfMPTCanHoldConfid: Enables MPT holders to maintain confidential balances (encrypted balances) via ConfidentialMPT operations.
MPTokenIssuanceCreate.tfMPTCanLock: Allows the issuer to lock the issuance globally or individually lock an account's MPTokens via MPTokenIssuanceSet, freezing its transferability.
MPTokenIssuanceCreate.tfMPTCanTrade: Allows the MPT to be listed and traded on the order book (OfferCreate/DEX); without this flag the token cannot be exchanged via offers.
MPTokenIssuanceCreate.tfMPTCanTransfer: Allows holders to freely transfer the MPT between themselves; without this flag the token can only move between the issuer and each holder.
MPTokenIssuanceCreate.tfMPTRequireAuth: Requires the issuer to explicitly authorize (MPTokenAuthorize) each account before it can hold a balance of this MPT, similar to tfRequireAuth for IOUs.
MPTokenIssuanceSet.tfMPTLock: Locks the issuance (or the MPToken of the account specified in Holder) preventing transfers; requires the issuance to have lsfMPTCanLock enabled.
MPTokenIssuanceSet.tfMPTSetCanClawback: Activates the clawback capability (lsfMPTCanClawback) on the issuance; can only be activated, never deactivated once set.
MPTokenIssuanceSet.tfMPTSetCanEscrow: Activates the lsfMPTCanEscrow capability on the issuance, allowing the MPT to be deposited in escrows from that point on.
MPTokenIssuanceSet.tfMPTSetCanHoldConfid: Activates the lsfMPTCanHoldConfidentialBalance capability on the issuance, enabling the use of confidential balances for this MPT.
MPTokenIssuanceSet.tfMPTSetCanLock: Activates the lsfMPTCanLock capability on the issuance, allowing tfMPTLock/tfMPTUnlock to be used from that point on.
MPTokenIssuanceSet.tfMPTSetCanTrade: Activates the lsfMPTCanTrade capability on the issuance, allowing the MPT to be traded on the order book.
MPTokenIssuanceSet.tfMPTSetCanTransfer: Activates the lsfMPTCanTransfer capability on the issuance, allowing holders to transfer the MPT between themselves.
MPTokenIssuanceSet.tfMPTSetRequireAuth: Activates the lsfMPTRequireAuth capability on the issuance, requiring explicit issuer authorization for new holders from that point on.
MPTokenIssuanceSet.tfMPTUnlock: Unlocks the issuance (or the MPToken of the account specified in Holder), restoring its transferability after a prior lock with tfMPTLock.
NFTokenCreateOffer.tfSellNFToken: Indicates that the offer created is a sell offer (the issuer offers the NFT in exchange for Amount) rather than a buy offer; without this flag the offer is interpreted as a buy offer.
NFTokenMint.tfBurnable: Allows the NFT's issuer (or its authorized account) to burn it at any time, even without being the current owner.
NFTokenMint.tfMutable: Allows the NFT's URI to be modified later via NFTokenModify; without this flag the URI is immutable after minting.
NFTokenMint.tfOnlyXRP: Restricts offers on this NFT to be denominated exclusively in XRP, prohibiting offers in issued tokens (IOUs).
NFTokenMint.tfTransferable: Allows the NFT to be transferred to third parties other than the issuer; without this flag it can only be returned to the original issuer, not freely resold.
NFTokenOffer.lsfSellNFToken: The offer is a sell offer for the NFT by its owner, rather than a buy offer; corresponds to having created the offer with tfSellNFToken.
Offer.lsfHybrid: The offer is hybrid and participates simultaneously in the public order book and in a permissioned domain's restricted book; corresponds to tfHybrid in OfferCreate.
Offer.lsfPassive: The offer was created as passive and did not automatically cross against an identical or opposite existing offer of the same pair when placed; corresponds to tfPassive.
Offer.lsfSell: The offer was created in sell mode, treating TakerGets as the exact amount to deliver and accepting a better TakerPays if the market offers it; corresponds to tfSell.
OfferCreate.tfFillOrKill: The offer must be executed in full immediately or, if it cannot be fully filled, it is cancelled without leaving any remainder on the book; incompatible with tfImmediateOrCancel combined with partial filling.
OfferCreate.tfHybrid: Creates a hybrid offer that participates both in the public order book and, if a permissioned domain is specified, in that domain's restricted book.
OfferCreate.tfImmediateOrCancel: Immediately executes the portion of the offer that can be crossed against the existing book and cancels the rest without leaving it posted as an open offer.
OfferCreate.tfPassive: Prevents the offer from automatically crossing against an existing offer that is exactly equal or better from the same issuer/pair; if it would fully cross, it is placed on the book without being executed.
OfferCreate.tfSell: Interprets TakerGets as the exact amount to sell, accepting more than TakerPays if the market price is better, instead of limiting the purchase to the exact amount of TakerPays.
Payment.tfLimitQuality: Requires that the payment's conversion quality (price) not be worse than the quality implied between SendMax and Amount, rejecting the payment if the best available path is more expensive.
Payment.tfNoRippleDirect: Prevents the payment from using the direct conversion mode via rippling on the issuer's own trust line, forcing the use of only the specified paths (Paths).
Payment.tfPartialPayment: Allows less than the requested Amount to be delivered if there is insufficient liquidity in the available paths, instead of failing the entire transaction; the delivered_amount field reflects what was actually delivered.
Payment.tfSponsorCreatedAccount: Indicates that the reserve of the account created by this payment will be covered by a sponsor (Sponsorship) instead of by the payment amount itself.
PaymentChannelClaim.tfClose: Requests closure of the payment channel; if requested by the source and the channel has no more funds or has expired, it closes immediately, otherwise it starts the agreed expiration period.
PaymentChannelClaim.tfRenew: Cancels a pending close request for the channel (Expiration) initiated previously, keeping it open; can only be used by the channel's source account.
RippleState.lsfAMMNode: The trust line belongs to an AMM pool rather than to a normal user account, identifying its special role within the AMM protocol.
RippleState.lsfHighAuth: The account on the 'high' side of the trust line has been authorized by the account on the 'low' side (issuer) to hold a balance of the token; relevant when the issuer has asfRequireAuth active.
RippleState.lsfHighDeepFreeze: The 'high' side of the trust line is in deep freeze imposed by the 'low' side (issuer), blocking both sending and receiving balance in that direction; requires the DeepFreeze amendment.
RippleState.lsfHighFreeze: The 'high' side of the trust line is frozen by the 'low' side (issuer), preventing the 'high' side from sending the token through the line.
RippleState.lsfHighNoRipple: Rippling is disabled on the 'high' side of the trust line, preventing it from being used as an intermediate step between two other lines of the same issuer from that side.
RippleState.lsfHighReserve: The trust line counts toward the owner reserve of the account on the 'high' side because that account was the one who originally created it.
RippleState.lsfLowAuth: The account on the 'low' side (issuer) has been authorized by the account on the 'high' side to hold a balance of the token; an uncommon case except in symmetric authorization setups.
RippleState.lsfLowDeepFreeze: The 'low' side of the trust line is in deep freeze imposed by the 'high' side (issuer), blocking both sending and receiving balance in that direction; requires the DeepFreeze amendment.
RippleState.lsfLowFreeze: The 'low' side of the trust line is frozen by the 'high' side (issuer), preventing the 'low' side from sending the token through the line.
RippleState.lsfLowNoRipple: Rippling is disabled on the 'low' side of the trust line, preventing it from being used as an intermediate step between two other lines of the same issuer from that side.
RippleState.lsfLowReserve: The trust line counts toward the owner reserve of the account on the 'low' side because that account was the one who originally created it.
SignerList.lsfOneOwnerCount: The signer list counts as a single owner reserve item (instead of one per list entry); applies after the amendment that simplified the reserve calculation for signer lists.
Sponsorship.lsfSponsorshipRequireSignFor: The sponsorship requires the sponsored account to co-sign for the sponsor to continue covering its transaction fees; corresponds to tfSponsorshipSetRequireSignForFee.
The sponsorship requires the sponsored account to co-sign for the sponsor to continue covering its owner reserve; corresponds to tfSponsorshipSetRequireSignForReserve.
SponsorshipSet.tfDeleteObject: Completely removes the existing Sponsorship object between the specified accounts, releasing any reserve or fee coverage it maintained.
SponsorshipSet.tfSponsorshipClearRequire: Deactivates the requirement that the sponsored account must sign (co-sign) to authorize the sponsor to cover its transaction fees.
Deactivates the requirement that the sponsored account must sign (co-sign) to authorize the sponsor to cover its owner reserve.
SponsorshipSet.tfSponsorshipSetRequireSi: Requires the sponsored account to co-sign for the sponsor to be able to cover its transaction fees, preventing unilateral fee sponsorships.
Requires the sponsored account to co-sign for the sponsor to be able to cover its owner reserve, preventing unilateral reserve sponsorships.
SponsorshipTransfer.tfSponsorshipCreate: Creates a new sponsorship relationship (Sponsorship) between the sender and the destination account, covering fee and/or reserve according to the SponsorshipSet flags.
SponsorshipTransfer.tfSponsorshipEnd: Ends the active sponsorship relationship between the specified accounts, returning to the sponsored account responsibility for its own fees and reserve.
SponsorshipTransfer.tfSponsorshipReassig: Transfers the existing sponsorship to another sponsoring account, replacing the current sponsor without interrupting coverage for the sponsored account.
TrustSet.tfClearDeepFreeze: Removes the deep freeze on the trust line on the transaction sender's (issuer's) side, once again allowing the counterparty to send and receive on that line; requires the DeepFreeze amendment.
TrustSet.tfClearFreeze: Removes the individual freeze previously imposed on the trust line, restoring its normal sending and receiving capability.
TrustSet.tfClearNoRipple: Once again allows rippling (payment pass-through) via this trust line, reverting a prior tfSetNoRipple.
TrustSet.tfSetDeepFreeze: Applies a deep freeze to the trust line, fully blocking both sends and also receipt of balance by the counterparty; requires asfAllowTrustLineClawback to be enabled on the issuer and cannot be combined with tfClearFreeze/tfClearDeepFreeze in the same transaction.
TrustSet.tfSetFreeze: Freezes the trust line, preventing the counterparty from sending the issued token through it; can only be applied by the issuer and requires not having asfNoFreeze active.
TrustSet.tfSetNoRipple: Disables default rippling on this specific trust line, preventing payments from using this line as an intermediate step between two other lines of the same issuer.
TrustSet.tfSetfAuth: Marks the trust line as authorized by the issuer; mandatory before the counterparty can hold a balance if the issuer has asfRequireAuth active. This flag cannot be deactivated once set.
Vault.lsfVaultPrivate: The vault is private: only accounts explicitly authorized by its owner can deposit into it, unlike a public vault open to any account.
VaultCreate.tfVaultPrivate: Creates the vault as private, restricting deposits to accounts explicitly authorized by the owner instead of allowing public deposits.
VaultCreate.tfVaultShareNonTransferable: Makes the vault's shares non-transferable between accounts, so they can only be redeemed via withdrawal, not sold or assigned.
XChainModifyBridge.tfClearAccountCreateA: Removes the configured minimum amount for cross-chain account creation (MinAccountCreateAmount) on the bridge, disabling account creation through it.
universal.tfFullyCanonicalSig: Indicates that the transaction's signature is fully canonical according to the strict encoding rules; in practice mandatory for years, present in virtually every transaction signed by modern libraries.
universal.tfInnerBatchTxn: Marks the transaction as an inner transaction of a Batch; only valid in transactions included within the RawTransactions array of a Batch transaction, and never in the outer Batch transaction itself or in transactions submitted independently.
